title: After School Program Checklist
subtitle: Capture activity block, homework period, snack service, and dismissal roster; confirm late pickup and family communication.
description: After School Program records activity block, homework period, snack service, dismissal roster, late pickup, and family communication. After School Program evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this after school program stage-gated verification when staff must document activity block and homework period. Reconcile snack service, dismissal roster, late pickup, and family communication before the after school program handoff. Useful evidence includes the activity calendar, homework plan, snack roster, dismissal sheet, family message, and end-of-day pickup log. Ask the assigned after school program reviewer to confirm activity block against the organization's policy.

sections.title: After School Program starting details review
sections.guidance: Plan the activity block, homework period, snack service, dismissal roster, family message channel, and end-of-day pickup reconciliation.

blocks.label: After School Program people and reference

sections.title: After School Program checks and corrections review
sections.guidance: Check current after school program facts at point of use.

blocks.label: After School Program required checks
items: Activity block is identified for this record
Homework period matches the current request or source
Snack service is ready for point-of-use staff
Dismissal roster limits or questions are resolved
Late pickup is communicated to the responsible person
Family communication is confirmed at handoff
A changed after school program fact is returned for review

sections.guidance: Hold after school program readiness on any failed or pending item.
